description: This file defines the EntryCollection class in the OrangeHRM LDAP DTO namespace. The class manages a collection of EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects, implements counting functionality, and provides access to its internal collection array.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total count of entries across all contained EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects, with lazy evaluation and caching.

methods.name: getCollections
methods.description: Returns the array of EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects stored in this collection.
